=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:195-232 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In review_final_ci_sweep_stale_hand_back, the comment "read_failed, marker_failed, dispatch_failed, disabled, superseded or a timeout log `hand_back_failed`, and the marked head retries next tick" is wrong for `dispatch_failed` (including `reason=helper_missing`). The same "retries next tick" claim also appears in the agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md contractual log-prefix bullet and in the README `FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED` row ("retried next tick"). The cause: scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh posts the `ai:final-ci-failed:v1` marker (lines 317-324/329) before it dispatches (lines 333-344), so on the next tick `_pr_base_sync_count` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1992-2001) sets PR_BASE_SYNC_STALE_WORKFLOW_MARKED=false and the head is never handed back again.
  WHY: The head stays red with no review run until a push or stall recovery, while the code comment and contractual docs tell operators an automatic retry is coming. All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). Reviewers disagree on `superseded`: minimax_minimax-m3 says it also does not retry, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says it is not a stuck state because the new head gets its own final run. openai_gpt-6-luna reported this both under CORRECTNESS and under ERROR PATHS; the two are merged here.
- README.md:184-186 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` row ("`false` turns the pass off.") and the `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` row ("`0` turns syncing off") are stale. review_final_ci_sweep_main (scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:454-464) no longer returns early: it sets FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_OFF=base_sync_disabled and still visits every failed candidate. Each visit costs a `user` read plus a comments read, counted against FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK, and stale-marked heads still get hand-back writes. The cap_zero path (lines 249-256) now behaves the same way. The same stale claim is in agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md line 14.
  WHY: An operator who turns the switch off or sets the cap to 0 to save GH_PAT budget still pays per-tick reads and hand-back writes, contrary to the README operator reference. All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:327-331 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `stale_workflow_verdict` makes two separate contents GETs (head and base workflow file), while the issue limits this path to "at most one extra read (the two file blobs, or one compare)".
  WHY: openai_gpt-6-luna says every qualifying timeout-only run makes two extra API requests, one over the stated per-run read budget (MAJOR, mapped to high). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this finding: they read "the two file blobs" as a permitted option, and the GETs run only on the all-timeout path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:review_final_ci_sweep_stale_hand_back | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment "read_failed, marker_failed, dispatch_failed, disabled, superseded or a timeout log `hand_back_failed`, and the marked head retries next tick" (repeated in agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md and the README FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED row, "retried next tick") is false for dispatch_failed, including reason=helper_missing. review_final_ci_failed_main posts the marker at lines 317-329 before it dispatches at lines 333-344. `_pr_base_sync_count` then sets PR_BASE_SYNC_STALE_WORKFLOW_MARKED=false, and a re-run would stop at `already_reported` (lines 276-278). A real retry happens only for read_failed, marker_failed, disabled and a pre-marker timeout. superseded is not stuck.
  WHY: The head stays red until a push or stall recovery while the docs promise an automatic retry. Suggested fix: correct the wording in the comment, the agents.d fragment and the README row; optionally match `outcome=dispatch_failed` and give it a separate note.
- README.md:184, 186 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` row ("`false` turns the pass off.") and the `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` row ("`0` turns syncing off") are stale. review_final_ci_sweep_main (lines 454-464) now sets FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_OFF=base_sync_disabled and continues through the loop at lines 496-501. Each candidate costs a `user` read and a paginated comments read, counts against FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK, and stale-marked heads get hand-backs. cap_zero (lines 252-256) no longer returns 2 early.
  WHY: An operator who disables the pass to save the GH_PAT budget still pays up to 2 reads per failed head per tick plus hand-back writes. Suggested fix: update both rows.
- Verification notes: rejected the openai_gpt-6-luna scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py two-GET finding because the issue §15 allows "the two file blobs". The default-branch checkout in ci.yml lines 5226-5232 justifies keeping the visit behavior; only the docs are wrong.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh review_final_ci_sweep_stale_hand_back — add an elif for "outcome=dispatch_failed" that sets FINAL_CI_SWEEP_STALE_NOTE=" stale_workflow=hand_back_dispatch_failed", and fix the wording (est. 4 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:review_final_ci_sweep_stale_hand_back (lines 195-217) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `stale_workflow=hand_back_failed` log note promises a next-tick retry for `dispatch_failed` (including `reason=helper_missing`), but the system does not reliably retry the dispatch.
  WHY: Operators expect an automated retry that never comes, so the PR stays failed with no automated path to completion.
- README.md:184 (FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED row) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The docs say `false` turns the base-sync pass off, but the implementation still visits every failed candidate and makes API reads.
  WHY: Operators who set the switch to `false` to save API budget keep consuming calls for every candidate.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:review_final_ci_sweep_stale_hand_back function (LAST RUN DIFF comment block + grep case) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment "read_failed, marker_failed, dispatch_failed, disabled, superseded or a timeout log `hand_back_failed`, and the marked head retries next tick" is wrong for dispatch_failed and for superseded (whose marker names a different head). The failed-marker POST runs before the dispatch, so `_pr_base_sync_count` sets `PR_BASE_SYNC_STALE_WORKFLOW_MARKED=false`. The same claim is repeated in agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md ("the head retries next tick") and in the README FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED row ("retried next tick"). Because the prefix section is "Stable log prefixes (contractual)", this is a contract break.
  WHY: Operators expect a retry that never happens, and the head stays red until a push or stall recovery.
- README.md:FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED row | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row still says "`false` turns the pass off.", but the off branch no longer returns 0 early. It sets `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_OFF="base_sync_disabled"`, keeps visiting failed candidates (one `user` read plus one comments read each, counted against FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK) and still hands back stale-marked heads.
  WHY: The row claims zero cost and no hand-back; the script does the opposite.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:225-227; scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:317-345; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1992-2001 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment says a failed hand-back "retries next tick", but `dispatch_failed` has already posted the `ai:final-ci-failed:v1` marker, so `_pr_base_sync_count` drops that head from `PR_BASE_SYNC_STALE_WORKFLOW_MARKED` on the next tick.
  WHY: After a dispatch failure on a terminal skip (`up_to_date`/`max_syncs`), there is no retry, and the PR can stay without a review run until a push or stall recovery.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:225-227; scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:317-345; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1992-2001 (ERROR PATHS) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A transient review-dispatch failure after the failed marker is posted stops the stale marker from triggering another hand-back.
  WHY: The helper classifies `dispatch_failed` as `hand_back_failed`, but the posted marker makes the stale check false on later ticks, so there is no automatic retry, contrary to the comment.
- scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:stale_workflow_verdict, lines 327-331 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The classifier makes two separate contents GETs (head and base workflow file), while the issue limits this path to at most one extra read ("the two file blobs, or one compare").
  WHY: Every qualifying timeout-only run makes two extra API requests, one over the stated per-run read budget.
